articles.summary: Framework brings together State Streets broad capabilities to support growth across the Middle East Dubai/Abu Dhabi, UAE , 17 November 2026 : State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT) and Emirates NBD, a leading banking group in the Middle East, North Africa, Trkiye and South Asia (MENATSA) region, announced the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) under which the firms will explore opportunities to expand their relationship which spans more than a decade across State Streets global capabilities. State Street has provided fund administration and custody services to Emirates NBD Asset Management for more than a decade. The MOU creates a framework for the firms to explore opportunities across a broader set of capabilities, including the evolution of Emirates NBD Asset Managements operating model, potential investment solutions and market products, digital innovation and support for the growth of Emirates NBDs wealth business. articles.summary: New multi-asset ETF tracks an index that comprises assets with potential long-term growth, income generation and inflation sensitivity Designed, but not guaranteed, to support an inflation-adjusted fixed-dollar monthly distribution State Street Investment Management today announced the launch of the State Street ® SPDR ® Nasdaq ® MyPaycheck ETF (PCHX), a new multi-asset ETF that is designed to track the Nasdaq MyPaycheck Total Return Index (the “Index”). The Index comprises a diversified portfolio of ETFs offering exposure to multiple asset classes. It aims to provide investors with predictable, but not guaranteed, monthly cash flow while keeping the remaining portfolio invested for potential growth. PCHX seeks to provide a fixed-dollar monthly distribution adjusted semi-annually for inflation. articles.summary: New capability brings physical and synthetic financing together through a single provider, giving institutional investors more choice in how they access markets, finance positions and manage capital State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT) today announced the launch of its equity swaps offering, expanding its Prime Services platform from physical financing into a combined physical and synthetic offering. The new capability allows clients to gain synthetic equity exposure through total return swaps.
